# Three.js for the Ocean theme

Version: **0.187.0**, MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz

`three-ocean.module.js` is a local, minified ES-module bundle of the WebGL exports used by `ocean-scene.js`, built from the official npm package with esbuild. The procedural scene is retained as source; Ocean currently uses the owner's selected Loop Glow animation and does not load this module. No runtime CDN or npm installation is required to serve this static site.
